annotations.title: See a licensed clinician near you

description: When a person describes a symptom that a clinician should look at, find a wai clinic licensed where they are and show them what would be shared before anything is. Sends nothing. If they want to go ahead they tap Share and continue on the card, which calls share_with_clinician. For an emergency tell them to call the emergency number first.

assistant.description: The assistant this conversation is in.

country.description: The person's country, as a two letter code such as US or GB. Required. Ask if you do not know.

region.description: For the US, the state as its two letter code such as CA. Clinicians are licensed state by state.

summary.description: One short line in the person's own words, 80 characters at most, such as Sore throat for 4 days.

symptoms.description: Up to eight signs the person told you, each { id, label, value }. For a sore throat ask about and send the Centor signs with these ids: fever (with the temperature if known), cough, white_patches_on_tonsils, tender_neck_glands. Never a name, a date of birth or contact details.
